name: agentinbox
description: Read selected local Google and Microsoft mail and calendars through AgentInbox.

interface.shortDescription: Your selected inboxes and calendars, read only
interface.longDescription: Search selected Google and Microsoft accounts and read the messages or appointments you request. Account sign-in and sharing choices remain in the local AgentInbox app. Requested content can reach the assistant's AI service.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentInbox to find my unread mail from today.
Use AgentInbox to show today's appointments.
